tests.name: founding seat endpoint mounted and auth-gated (JSON 401)
founding-status reports seats of 1,000 and no code
marking the celebration refuses an unauthenticated write

tests.reason: Seating a member and granting the year are writes; staging writes reach production data, so the seat logic is proven by applying the migration twice to a local Postgres replica of the live tables (scripts/ci/test-vtid-04859-founding.sh, run inside the first suite) and by the route suites. The signed-in read is proven by the community-app staging spec (the registered test account gets founding:false).
